summary: CCC-built 100-ft wood fire tower near Apex, 1940; moved in 1951 to a new site with a 99-ft steel tower, last manned in 1981, sold 1986. Site today not described.

facts.design: 100-foot creosoted wood tower with catwalk and inside stairway (1940); from 1951, a steel Aermotor tower of about 99 feet on a new site
facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

The last year the tower was manned, per the Legeros history
The site reverted to its owner and the tower was sold

notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the Forest Lookouts page (the 1940 CCC build) and the Legeros Wake County forestry history (the 1951 site, 1981 last manned, 1986 sale). The record's 30.5 m height matches the 1940 wood tower; the 1951 steel tower was about 99 ft. The Legeros line for 1951 has a garbled character before the 99 figure, read here as feet. The record's point (35.71166, -78.80749) was not checked against either site. No source describes either site today; access and status are unknown. Legeros does not say who bought the tower in 1986.
